title_zh: 进入公共服务的选择
title_primary: 进入公共服务的选择

authors: Stephen B. Billings, Hugh Macartney, Geunyong Park, John D. Singleton
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper, we use narrowly-decided elections and housing transactions data to test for private returns from public office in the context of school boards in the U.S. We find no detectable effect of election to the school board on home prices in the neighborhoods of winning candidates. Stratifying by political affiliation reveals that homes appreciate in winning Republicans’ neighborhoods, but the estimate is not statistically robust. We do not find corresponding evidence for improvements in local school productivity, but we show that neighborhood public schools of Republican members also shift to serving more white students through attendance zone adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本文利用势均力敌的选举结果与住房交易数据，检验美国学区董事会中公职的私人回报。我们发现，当选学区董事对获胜候选人所在社区的房价无显著影响。按政治派别分层分析显示，共和党获胜者所在社区的房价有所上涨，但该估计在统计上并不稳健。我们未发现当地学校生产率改善的相应证据，但表明共和党成员所在社区的公立学校通过调整招生区域，转向服务更多白人学生。

title: The Meritocratic Consensus and Stratification in Higher Education
title_zh: 精英共识与高等教育分层
title_primary: 精英共识与高等教育分层
title_secondary: The Meritocratic Consensus and Stratification in Higher Education
authors: Zachary Bleemer, Jesse Rothstein
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: American colleges and universities are highly stratified by pre-college academic achievement, family background, and institutional resources. We study the meritocratic consensus in American higher education: colleges that high-testing students (who are generally also from high-income families) attend spend dramatically more on instruction than do those that enroll lower-testing students. Stratification by test scores has been largely stable since the 1960s, but the stratification of instructional resources has risen sharply since 1970 at both private and public institutions. Non-academic admissions criteria like athletics, legacy, and affirmative action are second-order in determining the allocation of students to universities. Potential economic justifications for the positive association of instructional expenditures with student prior achievement—q-complementarity between achievement and resources, convex social returns to high human capital, and incentives to invest in learning prior to college—have little empirical support. Resource stratification across universities has not increased in the past decade, largely due to increased public funding of universities that enroll lower-testing students through financial aid programs like California's CalGrant, but stratification within institutions is now rising swiftly.
abstract_zh: 美国高校在入学前的学业成就、家庭背景及院校资源方面高度分层。我们研究了美国高等教育中的精英主义共识：高分学生（通常也来自高收入家庭）所就读的大学在教学上的支出远高于录取低分学生的院校。自1960年代以来，按考试成绩的分层大体保持稳定，但自1970年以来，私立和公立院校中教学资源的分层急剧加剧。非学术录取标准，如体育特长、校友子女偏好及平权行动，在学生分配到大学的过程中属于次要因素。教学支出与学生先前成就正相关的潜在经济理由——成就与资源之间的q互补性、高人力资本的社会回报凸性以及大学前学习投资的激励——缺乏实证支持。过去十年间，大学间的资源分层并未加剧，这主要归因于通过如加利福尼亚州的CalGrant等财政援助项目，增加了对录取低分学生大学的公共资助，但院校内部的分层如今正在迅速上升。

title: Implications of information presentation mode for internal and external validity in consumer experiments
title_zh: 信息呈现方式对消费者实验中内部与外部效度的影响
title_primary: 信息呈现方式对消费者实验中内部与外部效度的影响
title_secondary: Implications of information presentation mode for internal and external validity in consumer experiments
authors: Christopher R. Gustafson, Antoine Champetier
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The causal impact of information on consumer decision-making has been a prime area of interest for issues including novel food technologies, nutrition, food safety, and food authenticity. Experiments are oftentimes the only way to estimate causal impacts of information, as secondary data lack details on individual-specific information exposure. Response to information is relevant for many policy questions and has been formally integrated into some policy processes, such as those related to provision of nutrition information. However, the standard approach, which exposes participants to information, may provide inaccurate predictions of real-world outcomes. In the real-world, consumers may choose whether to access information, driven by a variety of motives. Forced exposure in experiments may also unintentionally bias results—threatening the internal validity of the design—by signaling the information’s importance to participants. This study investigates how different methods of presenting information impact both the internal and external validity of research designs. Participants were randomized to one of four conditions: information exposure, opt out to bypass information, opt in to access information, and a no-information control. Our findings indicate that the information presentation method has large impacts on external validity, demonstrated by significant differences in results across conditions. Information provision mode also yields significant, though smaller, impacts on internal validity among the subset of participants who accessed the information. In the study, participants are exposed to information about honey fraud, a topic that is both present in general media and of concern for the beekeeping industry globally.
abstract_zh: 信息对消费者决策的因果影响一直是新型食品技术、营养、食品安全及食品真实性等议题中的核心研究领域。由于二手数据缺乏个体特定信息暴露的细节，实验往往成为估计信息因果影响的唯一途径。对信息的反应与众多政策问题相关，并已被正式纳入某些政策流程，例如与营养信息提供相关的政策。然而，标准方法——即让参与者暴露于信息——可能对现实世界结果的预测不够准确。在现实情境中，消费者可能出于多种动机选择是否获取信息。实验中的强制暴露也可能通过向参与者暗示信息的重要性，无意中引入偏差，从而威胁设计的内在有效性。本研究探讨了不同信息呈现方式如何影响研究设计的内在和外在有效性。参与者被随机分配到四种条件之一：信息暴露、选择退出以绕过信息、选择加入以获取信息，以及无信息对照组。我们的研究结果表明，信息呈现方式对外在有效性有显著影响，各条件间结果存在显著差异。信息提供模式对获取信息的参与者子集的内在有效性也产生了显著但较小的影响。在本研究中，参与者接触到的信息涉及蜂蜜欺诈，这一话题既常见于大众媒体，也是全球养蜂业关注的焦点。

title: The mortality gradient in town and country: Social class and childhood mortality in Sweden at the turn of the twentieth century
title_zh: 城乡死亡率梯度：二十世纪初瑞典的社会阶层与儿童死亡率
title_primary: 城乡死亡率梯度：二十世纪初瑞典的社会阶层与儿童死亡率
title_secondary: The mortality gradient in town and country: Social class and childhood mortality in Sweden at the turn of the twentieth century
authors: Marcos Castillo, Martin Dribe
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines social‐class and urban–rural differentials in childhood mortality in Sweden from 1880 to 1910, a period of steady mortality decline, ongoing industrialization, and urbanization. Urbanization brought improvements in water quality and sanitation but also increased risks from overcrowding, pollution, and infectious diseases. It remains unexplored whether these changes narrowed or widened the class gap in infant and child mortality. We use full‐count Swedish censuses linked to the Swedish Death Index (SDI), which provides near‐comprehensive coverage of all deaths and allows for reliable estimation of mortality in ages 1–9 years. Detailed census data enable analysis of parental household characteristics. Due to undercounting of infant deaths, we use under‐five sex ratios as a proxy for infant mortality. Results show a strong urban penalty in both infant and child mortality in the late nineteenth century, which diminished in the early twentieth century. Pronounced class differences existed in child mortality in both urban and rural areas but not in infant mortality. Although absolute class differences narrowed over time, relative inequalities persisted in urban areas but largely disappeared in rural settings. These findings reveal substantial inequalities in child survival during industrialization linked to both urban residence and social class.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1880年至1910年间瑞典儿童死亡率的阶层与城乡差异，这一时期死亡率持续下降，工业化与城市化同步推进。城市化带来了水质与卫生条件的改善，但也增加了过度拥挤、污染及传染病传播的风险。这些变化究竟是缩小还是扩大了婴儿及儿童死亡率的阶层差距，此前尚无研究探讨。我们利用与瑞典死亡索引（SDI）关联的全量瑞典人口普查数据，该索引几乎覆盖所有死亡记录，可对1至9岁年龄段的死亡率进行可靠估计。详尽的普查数据使我们能够分析父母家庭特征。鉴于婴儿死亡存在漏报问题，我们采用五岁以下性别比作为婴儿死亡率的代理指标。结果显示，19世纪末城市地区在婴儿及儿童死亡率方面均存在显著劣势，但这一劣势在20世纪初有所减弱。城乡地区儿童死亡率均存在显著阶层差异，而婴儿死亡率则未见明显阶层分化。尽管绝对阶层差距随时间推移有所缩小，但相对不平等在城市地区持续存在，而在农村地区则基本消失。这些发现揭示了工业化时期儿童生存机会中与城市居住及社会阶层相关的显著不平等。

title: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
title_zh: 地缘政治分裂时期的美国货币政策溢出效应、外汇与黄金储备
title_primary: 地缘政治分裂时期的美国货币政策溢出效应、外汇与黄金储备
title_secondary: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
authors: Aizenman, Joshua, Saadaoui, Jamel, Uddin, Gazi Salah, Yago, Naoki
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies whether countries with larger foreign exchange and gold reserve buffers exhibit smaller exchange-rate responses to US monetary policy surprises. We test a central-bank reserve balance-sheet channel in which large reserve stocks can deter speculative pressure by signaling credible dollar-liquidity capacity, collateral value, and future intervention capacity, even without contemporaneous reserve sales. For identification, we use high-frequency FOMC monetary surprises, minute-level exchange rates, and predetermined reserve holdings for 18 countries. Countries with larger dollar reserves exhibit smaller exchange-rate depreciations after US monetary tightening, while non-dollar reserves do not display the same pattern. Gold reserves are also associated with smaller depreciations. These buffer effects are concentrated in countries without swap and repo lines and are strongest where dollar exposure, especially external dollar liabilities, is larger. The results show that reserve composition and access to dollar liquidity facilities, not only aggregate reserve size, are empirically relevant for exchange-rate resilience.
abstract_zh: 本文研究外汇与黄金储备缓冲规模较大的国家，其汇率对美国货币政策意外变动的反应是否较小。我们检验了一个央行储备资产负债表渠道，即大规模储备存量可通过传递可信的美元流动性能力、抵押品价值及未来干预能力来抑制投机压力，即便当期并未动用储备进行销售。为识别因果效应，我们利用高频联邦公开市场委员会货币政策意外、分钟级汇率数据以及18个国家的预定储备持有量。美元储备较多的国家在美国货币政策收紧后汇率贬值幅度较小，而非美元储备则未呈现相同模式。黄金储备亦与较小幅度的贬值相关联。这些缓冲效应集中于未获得互换和回购额度的国家，且在美元敞口，尤其是外部美元负债较大的情况下最为显著。结果表明，储备构成及美元流动性便利的获取渠道，而非仅储备总量，对汇率韧性具有实证相关性。

title: An XGBoost-GAN framework for mapping PM2.5 and NO2 and exploring land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin
title_zh: 基于XGBoost-GAN框架的四川盆地PM2.5与NO2制图及土地利用情景探索
title_primary: 基于XGBoost-GAN框架的四川盆地PM2.5与NO2制图及土地利用情景探索
title_secondary: An XGBoost-GAN framework for mapping PM2.5 and NO2 and exploring land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin
authors: Junpai Chen, Yuxuan Tian, Junjie Yin, Xiaojing Zhu, Chenshuo Ma 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of air pollutants is essential for supporting air-quality management and land-use planning. This study developed an exploratory XGBoost–GAN framework to reconstruct annual PM 2.5 and NO 2 surfaces and to examine model-indicated pollutant-pattern differences under land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin, China. Annual observations from 113 monitoring stations during 2014–2024 were combined with multi-source auxiliary rasters, including aerosol optical depth, meteorological variables, land-use/land-cover data, nighttime light, elevation, and population density. Random Forest, Long Short-Term Memory, and XGBoost models were trained using 2014–2023 data and independently evaluated using 2024 station observations. XGBoost achieved the best overall performance, with R² values of 0.71 and 0.81 for PM 2.5 and NO 2 , respectively, and was therefore used to generate 1-km baseline pollutant surfaces for 2024. Two Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) models were then trained to translate land-use images into XGBoost-estimated pollutant maps, enabling scenario experiments involving plant, built-up land, and water-body configurations. Under the condition of exploratory mode response rather than causal analysis, the scenario analysis results indicate that multiple land use layouts are related to the local decrease in pollutant concentrations estimated by the model. This study provides a data-driven approach for joint pollutant mapping and preliminary screening of land-use planning scenarios, while highlighting the need for validation with observed land-use transitions in future work.
abstract_zh: 理解空气污染物的空间分布对于支持空气质量管理和土地利用规划至关重要。本研究开发了一种探索性的XGBoost–GAN框架，用于重建中国四川盆地年度PM2.5和NO2浓度表面，并检验在土地利用情景下模型指示的污染物格局差异。研究结合了2014—2024年间113个监测站的年度观测数据与多源辅助栅格数据，包括气溶胶光学厚度、气象变量、土地利用/覆盖数据、夜间灯光、高程和人口密度。利用2014—2023年数据训练了随机森林、长短期记忆网络和XGBoost模型，并使用2024年站点观测数据进行独立评估。XGBoost取得了最佳整体性能，PM2.5和NO2的R²值分别为0.71和0.81，因此被用于生成2024年1公里分辨率的基线污染物浓度表面。随后训练了两个生成对抗网络（GAN）模型，将土地利用图像转换为XGBoost估算的污染物地图，从而支持涉及植被、建设用地和水体配置的情景实验。在探索性模式响应而非因果分析的前提下，情景分析结果表明，多种土地利用布局与模型估算的局部污染物浓度下降相关。本研究提供了一种数据驱动的方法，用于联合污染物制图和土地利用规划情景的初步筛选，同时强调未来工作中需利用观测到的土地利用变化进行验证。

title: Assessing the alignment of land consolidation policies with the Sustainable Development Goals: A case study of China
title_zh: 土地整治政策与可持续发展目标的一致性评估：以中国为例
title_primary: 土地整治政策与可持续发展目标的一致性评估：以中国为例
title_secondary: Assessing the alignment of land consolidation policies with the Sustainable Development Goals: A case study of China
authors: Yasi Tian, Yice Zhang, Yan Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) requires mechanisms that translate global objectives into context-sensitive local policies. Land consolidation connects land governance, spatial planning, and sustainable development, yet systematic frameworks for evaluating its alignment with the SDGs remain limited. Guided by Fit-for-Purpose (FFP) principles, this study develops an SDG-oriented framework based on the Policy Modeling Consistency (PMC) index. It first applies content analysis to extract land-consolidation measures from a national policy. It then establishes a multidimensional mapping between policy measures and SDG targets through expert consultation, constructing an indicator system covering social, economic, ecological, spatial, and managerial dimensions. Differentiated weights based on provincial development orientations and indicators of local policy innovation are incorporated to reflect the FFP principles of purpose-driven, fit-to-context, inclusiveness, and flexibility. Using 26 provincial-level administrative units in mainland China as empirical cases, the results reveal significant interprovincial variation in SDG alignment. Spatial and managerial dimensions performed strongly, while the social dimension showed a relatively high mean but considerable variation. Economic alignment was weaker, and the ecological dimension recorded the lowest mean and greatest variation. Cluster analysis identifies three policy types, including institution-led, spatial and social response-dominant, and multi-dimensional synergistic advancement. This study extends FFP from project suitability assessment to SDG-oriented policy text analysis and proposes a transferable evaluation paradigm for land governance and broader spatial planning research.
abstract_zh: 实现可持续发展目标（SDGs）需要将全球目标转化为符合地方情境的政策机制。土地整治连接了土地治理、空间规划与可持续发展，然而系统评估其与SDGs契合度的框架仍然有限。本研究以“适用性”（Fit-for-Purpose, FFP）原则为指导，基于政策建模一致性（PMC）指数构建了一个面向SDGs的评估框架。首先，运用内容分析法从国家政策中提取土地整治措施；其次，通过专家咨询建立政策措施与SDG目标之间的多维映射关系，构建涵盖社会、经济、生态、空间和管理五个维度的指标体系。为体现FFP原则中目标导向、情境适配、包容性和灵活性的要求，本研究纳入基于省级发展导向的差异化权重及地方政策创新指标。以中国大陆26个省级行政单元为实证案例，结果显示各省份在SDG契合度上存在显著差异。空间和管理维度表现较强，社会维度均值较高但变异较大，经济维度契合度相对较弱，生态维度均值最低且变异最大。聚类分析识别出三种政策类型，包括制度主导型、空间与社会响应主导型以及多维协同推进型。本研究将FFP从项目适宜性评估拓展至面向SDGs的政策文本分析，并为土地治理及更广泛的空间规划研究提出了一种可迁移的评估范式。

title: U.S.–China trade conflicts and third-country effects
title_zh: 中美贸易冲突与第三国效应
title_primary: 中美贸易冲突与第三国效应
title_secondary: U.S.–China trade conflicts and third-country effects
authors: Qingzheng Cao, Dongzhou Mei
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Since the onset of the U.S.–China trade conflict in 2018, the United States has repeatedly imposed import tariffs on Chinese goods, and China has responded with retaliatory measures. Within a deeply interconnected global economy, we examine the role of the third country in shaping the macroeconomic effects of U.S.–China trade conflicts. In particular, when also subject to U.S. import tariffs, how does the third country’s behavior influence the effectiveness of China’s retaliatory measures? Using a three-country DSGE model that includes China, the United States, and the rest of the world (RoW), we find that U.S. tariffs reduce China’s exports to the United States; however, China partially offsets this decline by increasing exports to third-country markets, thereby mitigating the overall adverse effects. Under the U.S. “reciprocal tariff” policy, both China and the third country incur economic losses, and the effectiveness of China’s retaliation depends critically on the third country’s response. If the third country also retaliates, bilateral trade between China and the third country increases significantly, leading to substantial improvements in both economies, while the United States becomes the largest loser due to a deterioration in its global trade position.
abstract_zh: 自2018年中美贸易冲突爆发以来，美国多次对中国商品加征进口关税，中国则采取了相应的反制措施。在深度互联的全球经济背景下，我们考察了第三国在塑造中美贸易冲突宏观经济效应中的作用。特别是，当第三国同样面临美国进口关税时，其行为如何影响中国反制措施的有效性？通过构建一个包含中国、美国及世界其他地区（RoW）的三国DSGE模型，我们发现美国关税减少了中国对美国的出口；然而，中国通过增加对第三国市场的出口部分抵消了这一下降，从而缓解了整体不利影响。在美国“对等关税”政策下，中国和第三国均遭受经济损失，而中国反制措施的有效性关键取决于第三国的反应。若第三国也采取反制措施，中国与第三国之间的双边贸易将显著增加，两国经济均大幅改善，而美国则因全球贸易地位恶化而成为最大输家。

abstract: In monopsony models, wage markdowns induce deadweight loss and are therefore inefficient. Yet markdowns also arise in models with backloaded efficiency pay, where they are designed to induce effort among early-career workers and are thus efficient. To reconcile—and empirically distinguish—these two mechanisms, we build a dynamic model incorporating labor market power and endogenous effort. Estimating a team production model on novel data on U.S. public accounting firms, we find evidence of both: markdowns for junior workers and markups for senior ones reflect incentive-providing backloading, while monopsony power induces a ‘lifetime’ wage markdown of 15%.
abstract_zh: 在买方垄断模型中，工资折价会导致无谓损失，因此是低效的。然而，在具有后置效率薪酬的模型中，折价现象同样存在，其设计目的是激励早期职业员工付出努力，因此是高效的。为调和并实证区分这两种机制，我们构建了一个融合劳动力市场势力与内生努力的动态模型。基于美国会计师事务所的新数据集，我们通过团队生产模型估计发现两种机制并存：初级员工的折价与高级员工的溢价反映了激励导向的后置薪酬安排，而买方垄断势力则导致15%的"终身"工资折价。

title_zh: 超越城市甜点：蒙古首都过度集聚的企业层面证据
title_primary: 超越城市甜点：蒙古首都过度集聚的企业层面证据

authors: Diaz Sanchez, Jose Luis, Lkhagvasuren, Mijiddorj
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides the first firm-level assessment of agglomeration economies in Mongolia, focusing on Ulaanbaatar, the country’s dominant urban center. Using data from the 2021 Enterprise Census, the paper estimates total factor productivity for a large sample of enter-prises and examines its relationship with localization, urban diversity, and peer productivity. The results indicate robust positive agglomeration effects, alongside suggestive evidence of diminishing returns to localization consistent with an inverted U-shaped pattern. These non-linearities are most apparent in Ulaanbaatar and in manufacturing, although they prove sensitive to alternative agglomeration and productivity measures. Although the cross-sectional nature of the data limits causal inference, the analysis offers new micro-level evidence on how spatial concentration interacts with congestion, infrastructure strain, and potential spatial misallocation. The findings underscore the importance of urban planning, infrastructure investment, and the development of regional hubs to sustain productivity growth in Mongolia’s highly concentrated urban system, with implications for diversification beyond mining in resource-dependent economies.
abstract_zh: 本文首次从企业层面评估蒙古国的集聚经济效应，重点关注该国主导城市中心乌兰巴托。利用2021年企业普查数据，本文估算了大量样本企业的全要素生产率，并考察其与本地化经济、城市多样性及同行生产率之间的关系。结果表明，存在稳健的正向集聚效应，同时有迹象显示本地化经济存在递减收益，符合倒U型模式。这些非线性特征在乌兰巴托及制造业中最为显著，但对替代性集聚指标与生产率指标的敏感性较高。尽管数据的横截面性质限制了因果推断，但分析为空间集中如何与拥挤效应、基础设施压力及潜在的空间错配相互作用提供了新的微观证据。研究结果凸显了城市规划、基础设施投资及区域中心建设对维持蒙古国高度集中城市体系中生产率增长的重要性，并对资源依赖型经济体实现矿业以外的多元化发展具有启示意义。

title: ‘Dead man working’: A Place-based approach to occupational safety and health
title_zh: 亡者工作”：基于场所的职业安全与健康研究
title_primary: 亡者工作”：基于场所的职业安全与健康研究
title_secondary: ‘Dead man working’: A Place-based approach to occupational safety and health
authors: Augusto Cerqua, Costanza Giannantoni, Marco Letta, Gabriele Pinto
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite increasingly stringent regulations, there has been a concerning stagnation in reducing workplace fatalities. Can place-based policy targeting help? By coupling machine learning techniques with comprehensive data from Italy, we develop a place-based approach to workplace fatalities. Harnessing accurate machine forecasts, we construct a granular risk map and compare it to the allocation of on-site work inspections and public subsidies for occupational safety, uncovering limited overlap. Counterfactual estimates reveal that current public policies are effective only in areas flagged as high-risk by ex-ante machine predictions. A back-of-the-envelope exercise based on these estimates suggests that machine-learning-based targeting could prevent approximately 70 workplace fatalities per year, equivalent to around 6% of annual deaths, generating substantial social benefits. AI-powered territorial targeting can reduce the incidence and economic burden of this chronic issue while lowering the costs of policy implementation.
abstract_zh: 尽管监管日益严格，工作场所死亡率的降低却出现了令人担忧的停滞。基于地方的政策定向能否有所帮助？通过将机器学习技术与意大利的全面数据相结合，我们开发了一种针对工作场所死亡的地方性方法。利用准确的机器预测，我们构建了一个精细的风险地图，并将其与现场工作检查及职业安全公共补贴的分配进行比较，发现两者重叠有限。反事实估计显示，当前公共政策仅在前瞻性机器预测标记为高风险的区域有效。基于这些估计的粗略计算表明，机器学习驱动的定向策略每年可预防约70起工作场所死亡，约占年死亡人数的6%，产生显著的社会效益。人工智能驱动的地域定向能够减少这一长期问题的发生率与经济负担，同时降低政策实施成本。

abstract: I study the cost pass-through on retail prices in two oligopolistic retail markets defined by specific physical boundaries. Using this setup, I find significant evidence that markets ultimately operate as a single one regarding their level of long-run pass-through and speed of price adjustment, possibly indicating substitution effects. Moreover, pass-through in both markets is not a function of the number of market players, which is in contrast with previous theoretical and empirical studies. Finally, I show that although vertical integration has a positive relationship with the speed of price adjustment, it does not affect long-run pass-through.
abstract_zh: 我研究了两个由特定物理边界界定的寡头零售市场中零售价格的成本传导。利用这一设定，我发现显著证据表明，就长期传导水平和价格调整速度而言，这些市场最终表现为单一市场运作，这可能暗示着替代效应的存在。此外，两个市场的传导并非取决于市场参与者数量，这与先前的理论和实证研究相悖。最后，我表明，尽管纵向一体化与价格调整速度呈正相关，但它并不影响长期传导。

title: Hidden Vulnerability and Heat-Triggered Decompensation: Rethinking Urban Overheating Beyond Clinical Risk
title_zh: 隐性脆弱性与热触发失代偿：超越临床风险的城市过热再思考
title_primary: 隐性脆弱性与热触发失代偿：超越临床风险的城市过热再思考
title_secondary: Hidden Vulnerability and Heat-Triggered Decompensation: Rethinking Urban Overheating Beyond Clinical Risk
authors: Zhu, Mingyu, Zhao, Qunshan, Jin, Jiayi
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Urban overheating is increasingly recognised as a major public health challenge under climate change, yet existing frameworks remain heavily focused on acute medical risk and clinically vulnerable populations. This paper introduces \textit{hidden vulnerability} to describe a broader population who remain socially and economically active under ordinary conditions but experience progressive destabilisation during sustained indoor heat exposure. Drawing on a sensor-enhanced longitudinal housing survey in Southwark, London during the summer of 2023, combining indoor environmental monitoring with weekly health and wellbeing questionnaires, the study examines how overheating affects everyday urban life. The findings reveal that impacts extended well beyond thermal discomfort. Participants described cascading disruptions across physical, functional, and psychological domains, sleep loss, exhaustion, impaired self-care, reduced concentration, emotional strain, and increased caring burdens, that interacted and reinforced one another, progressively eroding the capacity to maintain ordinary routines. Critically, these processes were observed not only among participants with chronic conditions but also among those without formally recognised health vulnerabilities, suggesting that the threshold for destabilisation is lower, and more widely distributed, than existing frameworks assume. The paper argues that hidden vulnerability is an urban condition, produced by the intersection of housing quality, social infrastructure, and accumulated disadvantage. The response calls for a conceptual framework for redefining heat vulnerability beyond demographic and clinical categories, and an empirical foundation for a social cure approach to urban heat governance.
abstract_zh: 城市过热日益被视为气候变化下的一项重大公共健康挑战，然而现有研究框架仍高度聚焦于急性医疗风险及临床意义上的脆弱人群。本文提出"隐性脆弱性"概念，用以描述在常规条件下保持社会与经济活跃、但持续暴露于室内高温时经历渐进式失稳的广泛人群。基于2023年夏季在伦敦南华克区开展的传感器增强型纵向住房调查，结合室内环境监测与每周健康福祉问卷，本研究考察了过热对日常城市生活的影响。研究结果表明，其影响远超热不适范畴。参与者描述了身体、功能及心理层面的级联式干扰——睡眠剥夺、疲惫、自我照护能力受损、注意力下降、情绪压力及照护负担加重——这些因素相互交织、彼此强化，逐步侵蚀维持日常活动的能力。关键的是，这些过程不仅出现在患有慢性疾病的参与者中，也出现在无正式认定的健康脆弱性的参与者中，表明失稳阈值低于现有框架假设，且分布更为广泛。本文认为，隐性脆弱性是一种城市状态，由住房质量、社会基础设施与累积劣势的交织作用所产生。应对策略要求构建超越人口统计与临床分类的热脆弱性概念框架，并为城市热治理的社会疗愈路径提供实证基础。

title: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
title_zh: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验
title_primary: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验
title_secondary: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
authors: Martin Huber, Eva‐Maria Oeß
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We introduce an overidentification test of two alternative assumptions to identify the average treatment effect on the treated in a two‐period panel data setting: unconfoundedness and common trends. Under unconfoundedness, treatment assignment and post‐treatment outcomes are independent, conditional on control variables and pre‐treatment outcomes, which motivates including the pre‐treatment outcomes in the set of controls. Under common trends, the trend and the treatment assignment are independent, conditional on control variables, motivating a Difference‐in‐Differences (DiD) approach. Given the non‐nested nature of these assumptions and their often ambiguous plausibility in empirical settings, we propose a joint test using a doubly robust statistic that can be combined with machine learning to control for observed confounders in a data‐driven manner. We discuss causal models satisfying either common trends, unconfoundedness, or both assumptions. Applying the proposed method to publicly available datasets, we find that the test rejects the null hypothesis in two out of four cases.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种过度识别检验方法，用于评估两期面板数据中识别处理组平均处理效应的两种替代假设：无混杂性与共同趋势。在无混杂性假设下，处理分配与处理后结果在控制变量和处理前结果条件下相互独立，这促使将处理前结果纳入控制变量集。在共同趋势假设下，趋势与处理分配在控制变量条件下相互独立，这推动了双重差分法的应用。鉴于这两种假设的非嵌套性质及其在实证情境中常存的模糊合理性，我们提出一种联合检验方法，采用双重稳健统计量，可结合机器学习以数据驱动方式控制观测混杂因素。我们讨论了满足共同趋势、无混杂性或两者兼具的因果模型。将所提方法应用于公开数据集后，发现检验在四个案例中有两个拒绝了原假设。
